limitations: CPU simulator responses only, not model inference or GPU performance.
Very small 6-request stages at concurrency2 and4; timing includes simulator/client CPU scheduling on shared four-CPU6GiB node. No GPU/SLO claims.
Local result evidence fields are simulator.py local conventions (localhost, simulator), not independently observed Thalamus node/route/Flux/worker bindings.
Base image and mounted source are recorded separately; no baked adapter image provenance.
Simulator direct Service and sidecar checks do not establish Gateway/GIE/EPP path, TLS/auth, supported catalog, object-store upload or Thalamus acceptance.
Native sidecar shares loopback and adapter local mode was not changed; no fake GPU resources, model identities or production bindings.

installationDeviations: Kueue managedJobsNamespaceSelector.matchLabels restricts Pod-based integrations to kubernetes.io/metadata.name=thalamus-inference (local config, not upstream default).
Kueue featureGates.QuotaCheckStrategy=true and resources.quotaCheckStrategy=IgnoreUndeclared set as requested.
FairSharing and AdmissionFairSharing config explicitly null; feature gates remain upstream defaults, but upstream enabled predicates require nonnil config, so classical preemption is selected.

All Kueue workload webhooks with original namespace selectors locally restricted to thalamus-inference; Kueue resource/CRD webhooks unchanged. Local scoping is recorded in *-scope.json patch files and applied after kueue-configured.yaml.
Two exact upstream kube-system extension-apiserver-authentication-reader RoleBindings applied separately with parent authorization; subjects unchanged.
Versions, images, replica counts, resource requests/limits and KEDA configuration unchanged from pinned release manifests.
transientFailures: Initial KEDA Deployment writes failed while upstream broad Kueue Deployment webhook had no endpoints; resolved by scoped webhook patches and reapplying KEDA.
Kueue initial rollout timed out/restarted before required kube-system visibility auth-reader RoleBinding was authorized and applied; final rollout succeeded.
limits: No GPU resources, node/device spoofing, fake model workloads, queues, quotas, pool resources or sample autoscaling workloads were created.
No catalog/GPU scheduling, preemption execution or KEDA scaling behavior is established by controller readiness/discovery. Parent owns meaningful source-derived admission/GitOps checks.

Kueue skips ProvisioningRequest admission-check/provisioning controllers because cluster-autoscaler ProvisioningRequest API is absent; optional integrations whose APIs are absent defer their controller setup.
KEDA upstream admission webhooks retain failurePolicy=Ignore.
No public services/ingress created; all owned services are ClusterIP.
Resources retained for parent cleanup; no repository modifications or project builds/tests/lint/formatters.
